Safety Science Entity Atlas

Schematic diagrams of the inner structure of every model, theory, method and tool in the safety-science taxonomy. Plates are grouped by the field axis; clicking a plate enlarges the diagram and shows the entity's type, level, temporal orientation and function codes. The Types tab gives the definitions, decision questions and sources of the twelve entity types.
